# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source, not captured from a run
# fields: COMMAND_RPC_GET_CONNECTIONS::response_t, src/rpc/core_rpc_server_commands_defs.h:1737-1760
#         connections[] = connection_info, src/cryptonote_protocol/cryptonote_protocol_defs.h:47-116
# THE FIELD SET IS THE KV MAP (:89-115), NOT THE MEMBER LIST. `ssl` is a member (:52) with NO
# KV_SERIALIZE entry, so it NEVER appears on the wire. DESIGN.md §1b.3 lists it among the fields;
# this fixture omits it deliberately - see tests/fixtures/README.md, "Deviations".
# TYPES THAT BITE (DESIGN.md §1b.3, §5b): ip (:56), port (:57), peer_id (:61) and connection_id
#         (:81) are std::string here, while peer.ip/.port in get_peer_list.json are NUMBERS
#         (commands_defs.h:1341-1342). A u64 field against connections[].port fails to deserialize
#         every row. §5c renders connections[].port as an integer parsed from this string so both
#         arrays of `node peers --json` agree.
#         rpc_port is uint16_t (a number), rpc_credits_per_hash/support_flags/pruning_seed uint32_t,
#         address_type uint8_t.
# state values are epee p2p connection states; "normal" is the steady state, "synchronizing" the
#         syncing one (src/cryptonote_protocol/cryptonote_protocol_defs.h, get_protocol_state_string).
# Three rows: two outgoing (incoming false) and one incoming, matching get_info.json's
#         outgoing 16 / incoming 3 in kind though not in count - `node peers` shows a sample.
# address_type: 1 = IPv4 (epee::net_utils::address_type::ipv4).
# pruning_seed 0 = not pruned; 384 is a valid seeded value (log_stripes 3, stripe 1).
